# Boot-screen font assets

These unmodified OpenType files are bundled for the `axrd` boot-screen
examples. They are all licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; retain
the matching notice when redistributing a font.

| Font | UI role | License notice | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Fraunces.ttf` | large, soft display numerals | `OFL.txt` | `177ff6c0f14e5550a3c624247cd1189611d4eb65d000b14944c63d967958abbb` |
| `DMSans.ttf` | card titles and controls | `DMSans-OFL.txt` | `8cd08d97e89c24d0aa92edd2f0f4c8ee6195eee9b7c9f154865a58b02f0c1c0d` |
| `DMMono-Regular.ttf` | compact system labels | `DMMono-OFL.txt` | `55b4c98f123daebb3ed27947ba47b2af00554fc6284d639a540bcef5e6258ad2` |

Sources: the [Fraunces](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fraunces),
[DM Sans](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans), and
[DM Mono](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmmono) families in
the Google Fonts repository.
